[[Princess/Legends|Princess]] '''Allegra Amar''' was a former member of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] who ended up as a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Alongside [[Dirk Harkness]], [[Trent Jaspar]], and [[Slick (Rebel)|Slick]], [[Gender/Legends|she]] served at [[Edan Base]] on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]].
